seriesTitle: This City Is Ours: A Crime Family Saga

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Michael and Diana try for a baby. Meanwhile, his criminal empire faces a shocking betrayal from within after a shipment of Columbian cocaine is intercepted.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: As Ronnie and Jamie grow closer, Michael fears he is being usurped. Tensions escalate, and Michael makes a big decision.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Chaos ensues in the aftermath of a shocking death. Michael takes control, and the gang agree to smuggle the body back to Liverpool. Aboard the ferry, tension and suspicion runs rife.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Back in Liverpool, tension brews as Michael assumes leadership. Meanwhile, Michael and Diana's IVF is successful.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: An unexpected player causes trouble for the gang. Diana wants to be honest with Michael about her past.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Michael and Jamie agree to a winner-takes-all fight to decide who leads the gang, while a disappointed Diana has reached her wits' end.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: Michael and Jamie's rivalry is pushed to the limit, causing Michael to reevaluate his life.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Jamie remains suspicious of Michael, despite his attempts to walk away. Jamie goes rogue, leading to a gripping final showdown.
